rules.human_readable: Three (3) shifts of paid bereavement leave upon a death in the employee's immediate family (Local 3535 MOU, Article XIV, p.21). Authored by the reviewing analyst against the clause text.

Premium overtime compensation at one and one half (1.5x) the employee's regular rate of pay (Local 3535 MOU, Overtime Rate, p.8). Reviewed and approved by the analyst against the clause text; the drafted FLSA 182/192-hour cycle rules were deliberately not approved — they model the 24-day work period, a different pay branch than a premium overtime shift.
assumptions: Hours are premium-overtime hours beyond the 182-hour threshold of the 24-day FLSA work period (MOU p.8 s.3)
Regular rate is taken as the salary-schedule base rate; special-assignment pay and education incentive (p.8 s.2) are not on the roster and not included

rules.human_readable: 2.5% general salary increase upon completion of ten (10) years of service (Local 3535 MOU, Longevity Pay, p.12); corroborated by the 'Longevity >10 yrs 2.50%' column of the CY2026 incentive table (p.38, not citable as a second citation until the DSL allows one). Applies to base plus incentive/specialty pay excluding Education Incentive, so this differential runs after specialty differentials and before any education-incentive differential (priority 10 = lowest among differentials). Years of service come from the question and are unverified. round(..., 6) only strips binary float noise (53.40 x 1.025 -> 54.735); the extension is rounded to cents once by the engine, per the case rounding policy.
assumptions: Years of service are taken from the question and are unverified; the roster carries no service dates
The intermediate rate is not rounded to cents; only the extension is (case rounding policy)
rules._scenario: 8-hour overtime shift, 12-year Firefighter/Paramedic top step (longevity 2.5% into the 1.5x rate)
rules.approver: claude-agent:data-goldens (authored against the catalog p.12 text; not yet human-ratified)

Regular rate is taken as the salary-schedule base rate; no incentive or differential pay is on the roster or included

Years are completed whole years and come from the question, unverified; a question with no years stated falls outside every tier and is refused. The OCR text layer prints '7,38' for this cell; the second-engine re-read agrees (7.38).
assumptions: Years of service are taken from the question and are unverified; the roster carries no service dates
Hours per pay period are read off the p.22 table; 26 pay periods a year (7.38 x 26 = 191.9 ~ the table's 192 annual hours)
